title: LEAD DATA PRODUCT ENGINEER
description:
Job description: Lead Data Product Engineer 
 1. Role overview 
 The Lead Data Product Engineer will provide technical direction, hands-on engineering leadership, and stakeholder leadership for the project. The role combines the responsibilities of a Technical Lead and Data Architect with active, hands-on data engineering. The Lead will guide the engineering delivery team in line with technical standards. 
 The Lead will use deep technical knowledge to guide delivery teams, challenge assumptions, assess design quality, manage dependencies, identify risks, and support informed decision-making. They must be able to explain processes, issues, and Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) to stakeholders from a business-outcome and KPI perspective, not only from a platform or engineering perspective. 
 Role type: Lead role leading the engineering delivery. This is not a line-management role. 
 Experience: 8-10 years as a Lead Data Product Engineer in the Life Sciences / Pharma Commercial domain. 
 Expected balance of the role: 
 The Lead Data Product Engineer is expected to perform all three of the following areas and must demonstrate a strong balance across them: 
 Technical leadership and hands-on engineering: design, build, review, and optimise data products and pipelines, and lead engineering delivery. Stakeholder management: act as the primary point of contact and engage confidently with business stakeholders at a KPI and business-outcome level. Governance, documentation, and transition support: provide oversight to ensure the solution is documented, governed, and supportable. 
 2. Technology and domain context 
 Platform and tooling: 
 Orchestration: Apache Airflow Cloud: AWS Data platforms: Databricks and Snowflake Source control: Bitbucket Reporting: Power BI (primary visualisation layer) Architecture: Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) is already implemented. The Lead is responsible for owning, maintaining, enhancing, and, where required, redesigning it. Business domain: 
 Claims data and commercial performance data, including PP and NPP KPIs and their business context Field team data, and how commercial stakeholders use it for reporting 3. Key responsibilities 
 Technical leadership and engineering delivery 
 Provide technical leadership and direction across the project and lead engineering delivery in line with AZ technical standards. Hands-on design, development, and optimisation of data pipelines and data products on Airflow, Databricks, and Snowflake. Own the Medallion Architecture, ensuring the purpose and boundaries of each layer are clear and consistently applied. Review and challenge proposed architecture, data flows, integration approaches, data models, and reporting solutions. Design and manage Airflow workflows, including orchestration, scheduling, dependencies, refresh mechanisms, and operational management of pipelines. Define and apply data partitioning strategies to improve scalability and performance. Review delivery plans and technical designs to confirm that data movement from source systems to reporting layers is feasible and appropriately controlled. 
 Data modelling, business rules, and reporting 
 Review proposed data models using knowledge of facts, dimensions, data grain, relationships, KPIs, and aggregation logic. Confirm that business rules and metric definitions (including PP and NPP KPIs) are clearly understood, consistently applied, and traceable to agreed requirements. Review data lineage, dependencies, ownership, and downstream consumption of Gold-layer datasets in Power BI. Assess the impact of changes to source systems, pipelines, transformation logic, Gold-layer datasets, semantic models, and reports. 
 Issue investigation and RCA 
 Coordinate the investigation of data discrepancies, refresh failures, performance issues, and delivery concerns. Create RCA documents for issues identified across source, transformation, and reporting layers. Ensure technical issues are assigned to the correct owners and progressed to resolution. Stakeholder management 
 Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders and the business. Build effective relationships with business representatives, commercial and field stakeholders, product owners, delivery leads, data engineers, architects, Power BI teams, suppliers, and support teams. Translate technical considerations into clear impacts, risks, options, and recommendations. Communicate complex topics clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge. Manage expectations by explaining what is known, what remains uncertain, and what decisions are required. Identify technical risks, cross-team dependencies, assumptions, and delivery blockers early. Governance and transition to business-as-usual (BAU) 
 Assess whether the solution is technically and operationally ready for transition into BAU support. Maintain full knowledge of the required transition artefacts: architecture diagrams, data lineage, runbooks, monitoring, SLAs, support models, ownership, and data quality rules. Identify readiness gaps and agree remediation plans with delivery and operational stakeholders. Provide a clear recommendation: ready for transition, ready with agreed risks, or not ready for sign-off. 
 4. Required knowledge and skills 
 Data architecture and engineering 
 Medallion Architecture (bronze, silver, gold) and the implications of each layer Data lineage, source-to-target dependencies, ownership, and downstream consumption ETL and ELT patterns, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, scheduling, and refresh mechanisms Apache Airflow: workflow design, orchestration, and operational management Databricks: architecture, engineering practices, and hands-on implementation Snowflake: architecture, platform capabilities, and data engineering best practices Data partitioning strategies for scalability and performance optimisation Common pipeline failure points, data quality issues, integration risks, and operational dependencies End-to-end data flow from source systems through transformation layers to reporting and analytics AWS cloud services and Bitbucket-based code management Data modelling and reporting 
 Fact and dimension tables, data grain, relationships, keys, measures, and aggregation logic KPI definitions, business rules, semantic models, and consumption of Gold-layer datasets by Power BI Investigating data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues Producing RCA documentation across source, transformation, and reporting layers Domain knowledge (life sciences / pharma commercial) 
 Claims data and commercial performance data, including PP and NPP KPIs and their business context How field teams operate and how commercial stakeholders use field data for reporting Ability to engage at a business outcome and KPI level Technical leadership and governance 
 Experience reviewing solution documentation, delivery plans, operational models, support arrangements, and transition artefacts Understanding of risks from incomplete documentation, unclear ownership, insufficient monitoring, weak data quality controls, and unsupported dependencies Ability to make balanced recommendations based on technical evidence, business impact, delivery constraints, and operational risk Stakeholder and delivery management 
 Proven experience working with senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary delivery teams Ability to influence outcomes without direct line management responsibility Experience managing expectations, resolving ambiguity, facilitating decisions, and communicating risks Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting technical information to non-technical audiences 
 5. Desired abilities 
 Fact-based approach and an eager-to-learn mindset Credible technical direction, acting as the businesss point of contact Ability to explain bronze, silver, and gold architecture implications to both technical and business audiences Effective challenge of data engineering, modelling, reporting, and integration proposals Early identification of risks and dependencies before they become delivery or operational issues Clear understanding and assurance of business rules, KPI definitions, data lineage, and ownership Coordination of stakeholders and technical teams to reach timely, well-informed decisions Confidence-building that the solution is supportable, governed, documented, and transition-ready Clear communication of readiness recommendations at each project stage 
 6. Qualifications and experience summary 
 Experience: 8-10 years as a Lead Data Product Engineer 
 Industry: Life Sciences / Pharma Commercial domain 
 Core platforms: Airflow, AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, Bitbucket 
 Reporting: Power BI 
 Architecture: Medallion Architecture (existing; ownership and evolution required)

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
ROLE SUMMARY The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable. The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix - Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions - ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks. The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations. 
 
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments. Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology. Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained. Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership. Integration and Data Engineering Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms. Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements. DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management. Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control. Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles. Vendor and Managed Service Delivery Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance. Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams. Enterprise Technology Alignment Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability. Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums. Organisational Leadership Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8-10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources. Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality. Compliance, Risk and Governance Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements. Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management. 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 Basic Qualifications Bachelors degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application. Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies. Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline. Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management. Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context. Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon). Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions. Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes. Recognised cloud or architecture certification. 
 PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work. 
 
 NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Occasional travel up to 20% Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare. 
 
 ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS 
 Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead. Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation. External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners. 
 
 RESOURCES MANAGED 
 Financial Accountability Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation
 Supervision Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleagues leadership. 
 Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; } Short Description We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data Platform to lead a team of engineers responsible for building and scaling a modern enterprise data platform. This role combines people leadership, platform architecture, and hands-on software engineering. The successful candidate will lead the development of a scalable data ingestion platform that collects data from manufacturing plants, enterprise applications, operational systems, IoT devices, databases, APIs, and streaming sources, transforming it into trusted, governed, and consumable data products within our enterprise data lake. This is a hands-on leadership role where the Engineering Manager is expected to actively contribute to technical design, software development, troubleshooting, and platform innovation while mentoring and growing a high-performing engineering team. Description We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data Platform to lead the design, development, and operation of our next-generation data platform. As a technology leader, you will be responsible for managing a team of engineers while remaining deeply involved in architecture, solution design, and software development. You should be equally comfortable defining technical strategy, reviewing architecture, mentoring engineers, and stepping in as a Senior Developer when complex technical challenges arise. You will lead the development of a platform-first ecosystem that enables the efficient onboarding, processing, governance, and consumption of data from diverse enterprise and manufacturing environments. The platform will support analytics, reporting, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and operational decision-making across the organisation. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers, Product Managers, business stakeholders, and data consumers to ensure data is reliable, secure, governed, and accessible at scale. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering management capabilities with deep expertise in data platforms, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and modern AI-enabled engineering practices. Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software, platform, and data engineers. Drive engineering excellence through coaching, code reviews, technical guidance, and best practices. Manage hiring, onboarding, performance development, and career growth of team members. Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Define team goals and ensure alignment with business and platform objectives. Drive delivery excellence through effective prioritisation, planning, and execution. title: Principal, Data Engineer
description:
Position Summary... What youll do... About Team GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmarts AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 
 What Youll Do - Design, build, and operate large-scale batch and streaming data pipelines using Spark, Java, and Python, processing data at Walmart scale. - Apply strong software engineering fundamentals - clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, code review discipline - to data engineering work; this is a software engineering role that specializes in data, not a script-writing role. - Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous data and platform problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term durability before writing a line of code. - Flex into platform/software engineering work when needed: build and maintain services, APIs, and distributed systems that data pipelines depend on, contributing directly to GDFs broader platform codebase. - Integrate AI, GenAI, and agentic capabilities directly into the data platform: embeddings/vector search for data discovery, LLM-assisted data quality and anomaly detection, agentic pipeline monitoring and self-healing, AI-assisted schema and lineage documentation. - Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to build feature pipelines, model-serving data paths, and the data infrastructure that MLOps depends on. - Own data quality, observability, and governance for the pipelines and datasets you build, with a strong Operational Excellence / Engineering Excellence discipline. - Participate in and lead architecture and design reviews spanning both data engineering and platform engineering domains. - As a Principal engineer, set technical direction and best practices across multiple teams and the broader GDF platform without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDFs broader data engineering standards. - Continuously evaluate emerging Big Data, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 
 What Youll Bring - Genuinely hands-on coding: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant hands-on data engineering at scale; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required, and strong working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is required, not optional. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. - Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward. - Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. - Deep experience with the Big Data ecosystem - Spark, Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, Kafka, workflow orchestration (Airflow or equivalent) - not just conceptual awareness. - Working literacy in platform engineering: microservices, API design, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration, CI/CD, and cloud-native practices - enough to flex into platform/software engineering work confidently. - The ideal candidate understands that modern governance extends beyond compliance and documentation. They will build the metadata, business context, semantic models, and trust frameworks that enable humans and AI agents to consistently discover, understand, and use enterprise data at scale. This role will partner closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, AI/ML, Enterprise Architecture, Business Teams, and Product Leaders to create an enterprise knowledge foundation that supports analytics, generative AI, agentic workflows, and data-driven decision making. Metadata & Knowledge Management Lead implementation and optimization of Atlan, Alation, Purview, or similar governance platforms. Create governance processes for capturing business context and institutional knowledge. Semantic Layer & Data Products Define enterprise semantic layer strategy across analytics and AI platforms. Enable consistent business logic across reporting, analytics, AI solutions, and self-service platforms. AI & Agent Readiness Establish governance frameworks for AI-ready data assets. Create structures that enable AI systems and autonomous agents to understand business context, metrics, definitions, and relationships. Define standards for contextual metadata, business rules, semantic relationships, and knowledge representation. Partner with AI and Data Science teams to ensure trusted, governed data is available for AI applications. Develop governance controls for AI-generated insights and agent-based decision support systems. Data Quality & Trust Establish enterprise-wide data quality standards, monitoring, and remediation processes. Define critical data elements and associated quality metrics. Develop trust scores, certification processes, and governance workflows for enterprise data assets. Drive continuous improvement of data reliability and usability. Lineage & Impact Analysis Build end-to-end visibility of data lineage across enterprise platforms. Establish impact analysis processes for changes to critical data assets. Stakeholder Leadership Partner with business leaders to define ownership and stewardship for critical data domains. Facilitate governance councils and cross-functional data communities. Strong understanding of metadata management, business glossaries, lineage, cataloging, and data quality frameworks. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting Generative AI, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graph, RAG, or AI governance initiatives. Knowledge of semantic technologies, ontology design, taxonomy management, and knowledge representation. Experience implementing data mesh or domain-oriented data ownership models. Familiarity with AI observability, model governance, and responsible AI principles. Experience defining context frameworks that improve AI and agent understanding of enterprise information.

title: ETL Automation tester
description:

In this role, you will lead the end to end quality strategy for large scale data pipelinesfrom test planning and requirement traceability to test execution and automated reporting. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Python, PySpark, Pandas, and Robot Framework, coupled with modern AI driven development tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate SQL query generation and schema validation across complex data architectures.
 
 Role Details
 . Job Title: ETL Automation Tester
. Employment Type: Full time
. Location: Hybrid {Bengaluru or Chennai}
. Experience : 3+
 Key Responsibilities
 
1. Framework Architecture & Technical Leadership
 . Enhance Frameworks: Design, build, and maintain scalable, reusable ETL automation test frameworks using Python, PySpark, Pandas, and Robot Framework.
. Data Orchestration: Develop PySpark based orchestration mechanisms to execute SQL queries and perform high performance comparisons and validations on large, complex data volumes.
. Data Injection & Feed Handling: Design configurable data injection strategies and validate source feed consumption across varied streaming and batch architectures.
. AI Assisted Engineering: Leverage GitHub Copilot to auto generate complex SQL queries directly from data transformation mapping rules, database schemas, and data models.
 2. Test Planning, Strategy & Traceability
 . Requirement Traceability: Construct and maintain a robust Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) to ensure 100% test coverage across data transformation rules and business logic.
. Test Data Management: Establish robust test data management and synthetic data injection methodologies to simulate production workloads.
 3. Reporting, Validation & Quality Assurance
 . Advanced Report Validation: Build automated report validation workflows using Pandas alongside Pyodbc, Pandera (data validation/schema enforcement), Pywinauto, and Excel parsing libraries.
. Defect Life Cycle & Execution: Lead test execution cycles, log detailed data defects, collaborate closely with data engineering teams, and deliver accurate execution metrics to stakeholders.
 Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Competencies
 . Programming & Scripting: Expert proficiency in Python, including deep familiarity with core libraries (Pandas, Pyodbc, Pandera).
. Big Data & Query Orchestration: Strong experience with PySpark for querying and validating multi gigabyte/terabyte scale datasets.
. Test Automation Frameworks: Proven experience architecting test automation suites using Robot Framework tailored for data and ETL pipelines.
. AI Tooling & Code Generation: Hands on experience utilizing GitHub Copilot (or similar LLM driven developer tools) for automated SQL query generation based on source to target mapping documents.
. SQL & Data Modeling: Advanced SQL skills with deep knowledge of relational databases, data warehousing concepts, and data transformation logic.
. Reporting & UI/Desktop Automation: Experience with Pywinauto and Python Excel libraries (openpyxl, xlsxwriter) for automated report verification.
 Professional Experience & Soft Skills
 . Experience: 3+ years in Data / ETL Testing,
. Testing Lifecycle: Demonstrated mastery of QA methodologies, Test Plan creation, RTM maintenance, execution tracking, and metric reporting.
. Analytical & Problem Solving: Exceptional ability to diagnose complex data discrepancies between source and target systems.
. Communication: Strong communication skills to liaise effectively between business analysts, data architects, and software engineering teams.
 Preferred Qualifications
 . Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, AWS Redshift).
. Familiarity with CI/CD integration for test automation suites (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
. Knowledge of regulatory compliance standards and data governance frameworks.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Overview 
Under the mission of "Money Forward. Move your life forward," Money Forward aims to resolve the financial concerns and anxieties of individuals and businesses through the power of technology.
We have partnered with Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation to establish a new company in preparation for the launch of a new digital bank.
We are currently seeking candidates for the position of Data Engineer as part of this initiative.
*Based on the press release announced on April 16, 2025.

 This position involves employment with Money Forward, Inc., and a secondment to the new company (SMBC Money Forward Bank Preparatory Corporation). The evaluation system and employee benefits will follow the policies of Money Forward, Inc.

 Responsibilities and Duties 
As a Mid-level Data Engineer in the MIDAS (Management Integration & Data Analytics System) Data Platform Team, you will build from scratch and maintain the central data hub connecting most systems within one of Japan's more innovative digital banks. You will work with modern cloud-based data technologies to ingest data from various banking systems, apply complex business logic, and serve it to downstream systems for enterprise management, regulatory reporting, risk management, and many other applications. Due to the high expectations in the banking domain, you will face complex data engineering challenges including data quality, reconciliation across systems, time-critical data processing, and complete traceability. This mid-level position allows you to work with increasing independence on data pipeline development while collaborating closely with senior engineers and the technical lead for guidance on complex problems. 
 Required Skills and Experience 
 5-8 years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering
 Strong proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python
 Hands-on experience building data pipelines using tools like Databricks, dbt, or similar
 Experience with AWS and its object storage
 Understanding of data modeling concepts including dimensional modeling and fact/dimension tables
 Experience with data quality validation and testing
 Ability to debug and troubleshoot data pipeline issues
 Experience with version control (Git) and basic understanding of CI/CD concepts
 Understanding of basic data governance: access control and audit logging
 Good problem-solving skills and ability to work with moderate independence
 Good communication skills and willingness to ask questions when blocked
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 Preferred Skills and Experience 
While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following.
 Experience in financial services, fintech, or regulated industries
 Basic knowledge of banking domain concepts: core banking, payments, or regulatory reporting
 Exposure to data platforms in regulated environments (FISC Guidelines, GDPR, APPI)
 Hands-on experience with Databricks platform or AWS native data services
 Experience with performance tuning: partitioning strategies, file formats, query optimization
 Experience building REST APIs with Python (FastAPI, Flask, or similar)
 Knowledge of streaming data pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar)
 Basic experience with Terraform
 Experience with BI tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Looker, PowerBI)
 Experience with data visualization and dashboard design
 Interest in obtaining certifications (AWS Certified Data Analytics, Databricks certifications)
 Experience in AI development and/or experience in using AI tools to improve development processes.
 Money Forward recently announced our AI Strategy roadmap which focuses on improving AI-driven operational efficiencies, as well as integrating AI agents into our products to deliver better value to our users. 
 Technology Stack 
 Cloud Infrastructure :
 AWS (primary cloud platform in Tokyo region)
 S3 for data lake storage with VPC networking for secure connectivity
 AWS IAM for security and access management
 Data Lakehouse Architecture :
 Modern lakehouse architecture using Delta Lake for ACID transactions, time-travel, and schema evolution
 Columnar storage formats (Parquet) optimized for analytics
 Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion architecture for progressive data refinement
 Partition strategies and Z-ordering for query performance
 Unity Catalog for centralized governance and metadata management
 Orchestration & Processing :
 Databricks Workflows for managed workflow orchestration
 Distributed data processing with Apache Spark on Databricks clusters
 Serverless compute and auto-scaling clusters for cost optimization
 Streaming and batch ingestion patterns with Databricks AutoLoader
 Data Transformation :
 dbt (data build tool) for SQL-based analytics engineering
 Delta Live Tables for declarative ETL pipelines with built-in data quality
 SQL and Python for data transformations
 Incremental materialization strategies for efficiency
 Query & Analytics :
 Databricks SQL for high-performance analytics queries
 Serverless and auto-scaling SQL warehouses for variable workloads
 Auto-scaling compute for variable workloads
 Query result caching and optimization
 REST APIs for data serving to downstream consumers
 Data Quality & Governance :
 Automated data quality with Delta Live Tables expectations and Great Expectations
 Cross-system reconciliation and validation logic
 Fine-grained access control with column/row-level security using Unity Catalog
 Automated data lineage tracking for regulatory compliance
 Audit logging and 10-year data retention policies
 Business Intelligence :
 Amazon QuickSight and/or Databricks SQL Dashboards
 Integration with enterprise BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) 
 Version Control : GitHub
 CI/CD : GitHub Actions
 Infrastructure as Code : Terraform
 Monitoring : Databricks monitoring, AWS CloudWatch integration
 AI-Assisted Development : Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT
 Development Structure 
We operate in a small, agile team while collaborating closely with partners from the banking industry. The MIDAS team is growing rapidly, aiming for more than 10 data engineers within this year. 
 Location: Chennai
 Work Mode: Hybrid 3 days from office and 2 days work from home.

Architect solutions on Databricks , including Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, notebooks, SQL Warehouses, and data sharing capabilities.
